pdp.halb.hinweis: A single one for your second piercing, or to mix with another pair.
pdp.handhabung.schritt1: Push in. The post slides through the piercing like any ordinary stud.
pdp.handhabung.schritt2: A quarter turn on the earring.
pdp.handhabung.schritt3: Click. The T-bar locks in crossways. It stays until you release it yourself.
pdp.handhabung.text: Closes with one hand. No mirror, no fumbling behind your ear.
pdp.mech.hinweis: You set the grip yourself by shifting the turned part of the post.
pdp.mech.schritt1.text: The T-shaped post lies lengthways and slides through the piercing like any ordinary stud.
pdp.mech.schritt2.text: A small turn on the earring, with one hand, without a mirror.
pdp.mech.schritt3.text: The bar now sits crossways behind your earlobe. It cannot go back.
pdp.mech.titel: How it holds without a back

pdp.passform.hinweis: The fastening needs room for a quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it cannot rotate. If in doubt, measure the thickness of your earlobe and {link}. We will tell you honestly whether it fits.
